selected.title: Ripple secures national bank charter; inks deals with BNY and Robinhood
selected.summary: Digital asset infrastructure firm Ripple has been granted approval to establish a national trust bank and struck separate partnerships agreements with BNY and Robinhood.
selected.why: Ripple secures OCC approval for a national trust bank charter alongside major institutional deals.

reason: Ripple's national bank charter raises genuine debate: does crypto infrastructure deserve banking regulation, or does this legitimize speculation?
angle: Granting national bank charters to crypto firms may entrench systemic risk rather than reduce it through traditional banking safeguards.
